identification: American acorn form shelf clock, laminated bentwood case with acorn-finial side arms, painted floral dial, etched/reverse-painted glass tablet. Torn label reads CLOCK MANUFACTORY ... J. C. BROWN (Forestville Manufacturing Co, Bristol, Connecticut, c.1847-50). Period original or later reproduction not settled by photos.

viewing_check: Open the case and check: label wording and print (genuine 1840s lithograph/letterpress paper aging vs modern photocopy), movement (brass, 8-day weight/spring, plate stamps, hand-filed vs machine-cut wheels), bell and pendulum, whether the tablet glass is old (wavy, bubbles) and the painted dial is original; case construction (laminated bentwood with old saw/glue marks, old shrinkage) vs modern lamination and screws; photograph the movement plates and the full label.
